notes: Half-rack-width unit: 8.76"W x 9.67"D x 1.735"H (1U tall, half of 19" rack width — typically paired with a second half-rack device or joiner bracket to fill a full rack space). All 4 NEMA 5-15R outlets are individually IP-controllable (RackLink), 12A rated/15A max total load at 120V nominal. Power is supplied via a detachable 9-10 ft cord (IEC C13 female to NEMA 5-15P male, included) into the unit's IEC C14 inlet, which has a cord-retainer clip — not a captive/hardwired cord. Ethernet port is explicitly documented as 10/100 Mbps (Cat5e or better, not provided); no USB port on this model. A recessed factory-reset button is present on the rear panel but is a control button, not a cable/signal connector, so it was not listed as a port. Sourced from Legrand's official "Select Series PDU with RackLink" User Manual (doc I-00768, current/2026 edition), cross-checked against Middle Atlantic's own "Select Series" datasheet (doc 96-01237, distributed via Markertek) which independently confirms 4 total/4 controlled outlets, IEC C14 inlet, and dimensions. Manufacturer's own middleatlantic.com/legrandav.com product pages did not serve full spec content to automated fetch (nav-only), so the manual/datasheet PDFs were used as the authoritative sources instead.
